subject: Discovery recap + 4-week trial plan and acceptance gates
body:
Message 1 (2027-04-12 09:02 PDT)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumahealth.com>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed 4-week trial plan

Hi Oliver / Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get the trial running next week: 

Summary (what we heard)
- Goal: Reduce triage time for appointment scheduling issues and deflection by surfacing structured recommendations from patient messages.
- Primary success metric: 25% reduction in manual triage time for the pilot cohort (20k messages / mo).
- Data constraints: PHI cannot leave VPC; we will run inference in your account (private deployment).
- Timeline target: 4-week evaluation window starting 2027-04-19.

Proposed 4-week trial plan
- Week 0 (setup): account onboarding, dataset ingest (anonymized sample), KMS key proof, baseline metrics capture.
- Week 1 (initial run): run on 10k messages, deliver side-by-side suggestions; collect qualitative feedback.
- Week 2 (tuning): adjust prompts/quantization profile, enable prefix caching for common templates.
- Week 3 (acceptance): run acceptance suite; measure triage time and suggestion accuracy; produce final report.

Success criteria (initial proposal)
- S1: >=25% reduction in mean manual triage time vs baseline.
- S2: >=85% precision on top-1 suggested classification for the pilot set.
- S3: zero PHI exfiltration events; keys and audit logs validated by your security.

Owners / roles
- Redwood AE / trial lead: Aisha Rahman (me) — commercial and schedule
- Redwood Solutions Engineer: Rishi Malhotra — technical setup, model variant choices
- Customer success: Monica Patel (cc) — onboarding and feedback loops
- Customer technical owner: Oliver Grant — infra and KMS access

Attachments: redwood_trial_scope_v1.pdf (trial scope), requirements_matrix.xlsx (data fields + sample mapping)

Immediate asks
1) Please confirm we can start the week of Apr 19 and provide a short-lived KMS test key and an infra contact (best: Oliver).
2) Confirm the two success criteria above (S1/S2) or propose alternate thresholds by EOD Wed 2027-04-14.

I'll kick off the onboarding checklist once we have the green light.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---

Message 2 (2027-04-13 11:18 PDT)
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@lumahealth.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Priya Suresh <priya.suresh@lumahealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed 4-week trial plan

Aisha — thanks for the clear plan. We like the structure. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: Apr 19 start is good, but we need a lite sandbox first (no production traffic) for the first 48 hours.
- Success metrics: S1 is OK, but can we add a qualitative acceptance gate: average CSAT for suggested replies >= 4.0/5 during Week 3? That matters for our ops team.
- Data: We can share a de-identified sample of 5k messages this week. KMS: I can provision a test key scoped to the account — will send to Rishi securely.

Also looping in our internal product manager Priya — she'll own CSAT collection and evaluation.

On owners: can Marcus Lin from your CS org be the point for escalation and weekly check-ins? He ran the last deployment with a similar healthcare customer.

Oliver
Director of Infrastructure | Luma Health

Thanks — quick technical note and checklist I'm going to run through this week: 

- Sandbox: we'll spin up a private VPC deployment in your AWS account. We will not touch production traffic until you flip the switch.
- Data ingest mapping: see attached requirements_matrix.xlsx; please confirm column names for the anonymized sample.
- Metrics collection: we'll instrument per-request latency, token counts, and suggestion precision. We'll also add a small endpoint for your CSAT collection to append results to the trial folder.

Marcus — can you take on weekly syncs? Proposed recurring: Fri 09:00 PT starting Apr 23 for 30 minutes (30m).

I'll wait for the KMS test key (Oliver) and the 5k sample drop to the drive link.

Great — thanks everyone for the fast responses. Quick status and checklist to keep momentum: 

Status update
- KMS test key: Oliver to send by EOD Apr 16 (received via secure channel expected).
- Data sample: Priya to upload 5k de-identified messages to the shared drive by Apr 15 (we have access).
- Sandbox: Rishi will provision the VPC once KMS key is received.

Action items (owners / by when)
1) Oliver — provision KMS test key and add rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai to key policy (due Apr 16)
2) Priya — upload de-identified 5k sample to https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1A2bTrialScope (done)
3) Rishi — provision sandbox and run baseline capture (due Apr 19)
4) Marcus — host the weekly checkpoint cadence (Fridays 09:00 PT) and send calendar invite (due Apr 20)

Weekly nudges: I'll send a quick Friday 09:00 PT reminder and a short checklist ahead of each sync so we can keep the trial moving. If anything blocks the sandbox/provisioning please flag in the thread and Marcus will escalate.

Thanks — excited to get started next week.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
